name: Bonsai 2 27B

based_on.note: PrismML retrained Qwen3.8-27B's weights to ternary {-1, 0, +1}. Same architecture; 5.9 GB instead of 54 GB. PrismML's 20-benchmark suite: 83.9 vs 85.4 for Qwen3.8-27B (98.2% retained).

architecture.layer_mix: 48 linear (Gated DeltaNet) + 16 full attention, every 4th layer full

summary: A ternary retrain of Qwen3.8-27B by PrismML: the 27B design in about 6-7 GB, so it runs on a 12 GB GPU or a 16 GB laptop with the full 262K window. Needs PrismML's own llama.cpp or MLX build.

practical_baseline.reason: Only sub-4-bit builds exist for this model, so the directory's 4-bit-or-better baseline policy cannot select one. Pick by your hardware.
